answer: Watch the pulse of submissions. The node logs how many milliseconds after epoch open each answer arrives. Keys whose delays land within 1.5 seconds of each other in 5 of their last 8 epochs are grouped and split one reward. A farm driving 300 keys from one scheduler fires them in a tight burst, so rotating IPs buys it no oasis from the check. Honest agents wake on their own clocks and spread across hours, like plants in a garden opening at different times. Each close publishes the timing table and group list.
